Individuals who, as of the effective date of this section, held a valid registration as a construction superintendent in accordance with rules promulgated by the commissioner shall be deemed to hold a license as a construction superintendent.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
